shop.name: shop
shop.title: One purchase through the shop
shop.prose:
A purchase arrives in the initial marking. The stock holds one item
of its sku.

steps.label: accepted
steps.title: the shop accepts the purchase
steps.prose: Accepting moves the purchase; the carry rule keeps its data.

steps.title: the purchase ships
steps.prose: Shipping reads the item and gives a parcel; the net fixes the receipt.

paths.name: late
paths.title: The purchase is not shipped in time

evening_shift.name: evening_shift
evening_shift.title: Evening shift
evening_shift.prose:
The clerk closes the desk, a runner takes one hold, and the clerk checks it
an hour later before the desk opens again.

steps.title: Check the hold
steps.prose: The check waits for the clock; nobody advanced it.

kitchen-sink.name: review_sla
kitchen-sink.title: A document review escalates once it is overdue
kitchen-sink.prose:
Region C of the kitchen sink. A queued document is assigned for review,
and the assignment escalates when the clock passes its due time.

steps.label: assigned
steps.title: assign the review
steps.prose:
`[assign_review]` turns a `doc` into an `assignment`. The net has no data
template for it and the colors differ, so the carry rule cannot fill it:
the step states the assignment.
A advance replaces the clock token's `now`. It fires nothing by itself.

paths.name: shipment
paths.title: A guarded transition fires under an assumed answer

steps.prose:
`[form_shipment]` has two accepted orders, stock for their sku and no open
shipment for their customer, but its guard is a named handler. A play
registers no handlers, so the transition is not enabled — until the path
assumes the guard's answer.

steps.label: shipped
steps.title: the assumed answer opens the warehouse

steps.prose:
The desk is closed, and the
hold waits.

paths.name: p
paths.prose:
One sentence that goes on
over two lines.

A second paragraph.
